data.one_liner: Allows throwing exceptions on specified method calls in fakes
data.what_it_does: Provides a small API to configure a fake to throw an exception when a particular method, getter or setter is invoked. It works by checking the invocation at the start of the fake’s implementation and throwing if a match is found.
use_when: Testing fakes that need to simulate error conditions
When you want to keep the fake’s real logic but occasionally trigger failures
When you need fine‑grained control over which calls throw
avoid_when: Using full mocking frameworks like Mockito for stubbing and verification
When you need to return values or capture arguments, not just throw
strengths: Focused only on exception throwing, no extra features
weaknesses: Only supports throwing, not stubbing return values
Requires manual insertion of maybeThrowException in each fake method
data.setup_notes: Add maybeThrowException(this, Invocation.method(...)) to the start of each fake method you want to guard. No build_runner or permissions needed.

alternatives.name: mockito
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides full mocking, stubbing, and verification capabilities, but is heavier and requires a mock class.
